name: Test Generation Output Still Leaking into Count Variable
description: Despite BUG-005 US-002 fix to redirect output to stderr, the syntax error still occurs on line 2545: [[: syntax error: operand expected. The generate_tests_for_completed_prds function is still capturing display output along with the count, causing the numeric comparison to fail. The fix was incomplete.

userStories.title: Trace and fix output leak in generate_tests_for_completed_prds
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the test generation count comparison to work without syntax errors
acceptanceCriteria: Identify all echo statements in run_test_generation that output to stdout instead of stderr
Identify any other functions called by generate_tests_for_completed_prds that output to stdout
Redirect ALL display output to stderr (>&2) in the test generation flow
Verify $tests_generated contains only a numeric value after function call

userStories.title: Add defensive numeric validation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the count comparison to handle unexpected values gracefully
acceptanceCriteria: Before comparison, validate that $tests_generated is numeric
If not numeric, default to 0 and log warning to stderr
Syntax error no longer occurs even if output leaks

userStories.title: Verify fix with end-to-end test
userStories.description: As a developer, I want confidence the fix works in real usage
acceptanceCriteria: Run fade yolo on a PRD that triggers ALL_COMPLETE
Test generation completes without syntax error in output
Archived PRD count message displays correctly
No error tokens visible in terminal output

technicalNotes.rootCause: BUG-005 US-002 fix was incomplete - not all output paths redirected to stderr
investigation: Check if run_test_generation has echo statements still going to stdout
Check if claude --print output is being captured
Check if any called helper functions output to stdout
May need to wrap entire function output: generate_tests_for_completed_prds 2>&1 | tee /dev/stderr
